tasks.title: Compare USCIS Filing Receipt Against Original Petition Submission — Discrepancy Report
tasks.instructions: Compare the USCIS receipt notice against the petition submission documents and flag all discrepancies, internal inconsistencies, and errors in a categorized report. Output: `discrepancy-report.docx`.
tasks.criteria_filter: severity ranking, prioritization, or recommending remedial or corrective action

criteria.title: Categorizes A-Number transposition as Critical severity
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the A-Number transposition discrepancy is categorized as Critical (or equivalent highest severity). FAIL if it is categorized as Moderate, Low, or not assigned a severity.

criteria.title: Recommends corrective action for A-Number error (e-Request/service request)
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report recommends filing a USCIS service request, e-Request, or contacting USCIS (e.g., InfoPass, USCIS Contact Center) to correct the A-Number on the receipt notice. FAIL if no specific corrective mechanism is recommended for the A-Number error.

criteria.title: Categorizes missing middle name as Moderate (not Critical) severity
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the missing middle name issue is categorized as Moderate severity (or equivalent mid-level severity). FAIL if categorized as Critical or if no severity is assigned. A Low severity rating is acceptable but not ideal; it should still PASS since the issue is debatable.

criteria.title: Assesses petitioner name styling as Low severity
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the petitioner name styling discrepancy is categorized as Low severity (or equivalent minor-level severity). Moderate is also acceptable. FAIL if categorized as Critical.

criteria.title: Recommends matching I-485 petitioner name to receipt notice version
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report recommends that for the I-485 filing, the petitioner's name should match the version appearing on the I-140 receipt notice (i.e., 'Helion Biosciences Inc') to avoid processing confusion, or at minimum flags the need to decide which version to use on the I-485. FAIL if no guidance is given about how to handle the name styling for the upcoming I-485 filing.

criteria.title: Recommends updating checklist template to use current fee
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report recommends correcting or updating the firm's submission checklist template to reflect the current I-140 filing fee of $715.00 for future filings. FAIL if no recommendation to update the checklist or template is made.

criteria.title: Categorizes missing I-907 receipt as Critical or High given timeline
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the missing I-907 receipt notice is categorized as Critical or High severity, given the April 30, 2025 I-485 filing deadline and the risk that premium processing may not have been properly activated. FAIL if categorized as Low severity or not assigned a severity rating.

criteria.title: Recommends verifying I-907 receipt status urgently
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report recommends that the firm urgently verify whether a separate I-907 receipt was received (possibly lost, misfiled, or never issued) and, if not received, contact USCIS to confirm premium processing is active. FAIL if no action item regarding the missing I-907 receipt is provided.

criteria.title: Report contains recommended action items tied to April 30 deadline
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report includes a recommended action items section (or equivalent) that lists corrective steps and ties them to the April 30, 2025 I-485 filing deadline, establishing urgency for time-sensitive items. FAIL if there are no action items, or if action items exist but make no reference to the April 30, 2025 deadline.

tasks.title: Identify Issues in Consular Processing Packet for EB-1B Outstanding Researcher Case
tasks.instructions: Review the attached consular processing packet, cross-reference all documents for inconsistencies or risks, and prepare an issue memo with severity ratings. Output: `consular-packet-issue-memo.docx`.
tasks.criteria_filter: severity ranking, prioritization, or recommending remedial or corrective action

criteria.title: Recommends unlocking and amending DS-260 to disclose criminal history
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo recommends that the DS-260 be unlocked and amended to disclose the arrest, charge, reduction to reckless driving, and disposition. FAIL if no specific corrective action regarding amending the DS-260 for criminal history is provided.

criteria.title: Recommends obtaining certified court disposition documents
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo recommends obtaining and including certified court disposition documents for Case No. 20-CR-84523 in the consular packet. FAIL if this specific recommendation is absent.

criteria.title: Rates the undisclosed criminal matter as Critical priority
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo assigns the undisclosed DUI/reckless driving issue the highest severity rating (e.g., 'Critical' or equivalent top-tier designation). FAIL if it is rated lower than the highest severity tier.

criteria.title: Recommends amending DS-260 to explain employment gap period
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo recommends unlocking/amending the DS-260 to account for the August 2014 to September 2015 period, even if Dr. Krishnamurthy was not formally employed during that time (e.g., personal research, preparation for postdoc, residing in Coimbatore). FAIL if no corrective action is recommended for this gap.

criteria.title: Recommends correcting and re-executing the I-864
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo recommends that the I-864 be corrected to list household size of 3 and re-executed/re-signed. FAIL if no corrective action for the I-864 is recommended.

criteria.title: Recommends affidavit or legal name change documentation for Priya
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo recommends obtaining a sworn affidavit, legal name change decree, gazette notification, or similar documentation to bridge the name discrepancies across Priya's civil documents. FAIL if no corrective action is recommended for the name discrepancy.

criteria.title: Recommends unlocking Priya's DS-260 to add missing addresses
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo recommends unlocking and amending Priya's DS-260 to include her address(es) during the approximately June 2019 to January 2020 period. FAIL if no corrective action is recommended for the missing address history.

criteria.title: Recommends updating Priya's DS-260 social media field
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo recommends unlocking Priya's DS-260 to either list all social media identifiers or affirmatively state 'None.' FAIL if no corrective action is recommended for the blank social media field.

criteria.title: Recommends supplemental employer letter with worksite details
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo recommends obtaining a supplemental letter from Meridian Biosciences specifying the exact work address, department, and/or reporting structure. FAIL if no corrective action regarding worksite information is recommended.

criteria.title: Recommends including explanation of prior 214(b) refusal in packet
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo recommends including a brief explanation of the prior 214(b) refusal in the cover letter or a separate statement to preemptively address consular officer questions. FAIL if no recommendation is made regarding the prior refusal explanation.

criteria.title: Recommends proactive substance abuse evaluation or preparation
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo recommends that Dr. Krishnamurthy obtain a substance abuse evaluation from a licensed professional, prepare for additional medical evaluation by the panel physician, and/or be prepared for consular officer referral for a Class A/B medical determination regarding alcohol use. FAIL if no proactive preparation recommendation is made regarding the health-related ground.

criteria.title: Each issue includes a severity/priority rating
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo assigns a priority or severity rating (e.g., Critical, High, Medium, or similar tiered system) to each identified issue, as requested in the task prompt. FAIL if no severity/priority ratings are provided for the issues.

criteria.title: References July 22, 2025 interview deadline as time constraint
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo references the July 22, 2025 interview date as a deadline or time constraint for completing corrective actions. FAIL if the interview date is not mentioned or not used as a framing element for urgency of corrections.

tasks.title: Compare PERM Job Requirements against H-1B Beneficiary Credentials for Senior Machine Learning Engineer Position
tasks.instructions: Review the attached PERM application against the beneficiary's supporting credentials and produce a gap analysis memo with remedial recommendations. Output: `credential-gap-analysis.docx`.
tasks.criteria_filter: severity ranking, prioritization, or recommending remedial or corrective action

criteria.title: Recommends remedial action for certification mismatch (ISSUE_001)
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo recommends at least one concrete remedial action for the certification gap, such as: (a) having Dr. Mehrotra obtain the AWS ML-Specialty certification before filing, (b) amending/refiling the PERM to remove the certification requirement, or (c) building an argument that the TensorFlow Developer Certificate is 'equivalent.' FAIL if no remedial action is recommended for this gap.

criteria.title: Rates certification mismatch as critical or high severity
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo classifies the AWS certification mismatch (required ML-Specialty vs. held Cloud Practitioner) as critical or high severity, or otherwise indicates it is very likely to trigger an RFE or denial. FAIL if rated as moderate, low, or minor.

criteria.title: Recommends remedial action for job title discrepancy (ISSUE_004)
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo recommends actions to address the title discrepancy, such as: obtaining a supplemental letter from the employer describing duties that map to ML engineering, securing an expert opinion letter, or ensuring the experience letters detail ML engineering duties. FAIL if no remedial action is recommended for the title gap.

criteria.title: Recommends obtaining NC State experience letter if needed
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo recommends obtaining an experience letter from Professor Helen Tsai or NC State University to document the Research Assistant position, or at minimum discusses whether such a letter is necessary. FAIL if no recommendation is made regarding obtaining this documentation.

criteria.title: Recommends remedial action for R proficiency gap
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo recommends specific actions to address the R proficiency gap, such as obtaining additional evidence of R usage (project samples, supervisor attestation, supplemental letter). FAIL if no remedial recommendation is made for R proficiency.

criteria.title: Memo includes recommendations for identified gaps
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo includes remedial recommendations for the identified gaps. FAIL if gaps are identified but no recommendations are provided.

criteria.title: Includes severity ratings for identified gaps
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo assigns severity ratings (such as Critical/Moderate/Low or High/Medium/Low or equivalent tiered ratings) to each identified gap or issue. FAIL if gaps are identified without any severity classification.

criteria.title: Recommends remedial action for team supervision scope mismatch
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo recommends actions to address the supervision scope mismatch (supervising 2 data scientists vs. required 3-5 ML engineers), such as supplemental evidence of leadership capability, training records, or an argument that the experience is substantially similar. FAIL if the supervision mismatch is identified but no remedial recommendation is provided.

tasks.title: Compare Job Requirements against Candidate Credentials — Immigration Compliance Gap Analysis
tasks.instructions: Review the attached immigration filing documents and supporting credentials for gaps, inconsistencies, and regulatory risks across both petitions. Output: `credential-gap-analysis.docx`.
tasks.criteria_filter: severity ranking, prioritization, or recommending remedial or corrective action

criteria.title: Identified issues include severity or risk ratings
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if identified issues/findings include severity or risk ratings (e.g., Critical, High, Medium, Low or equivalent). FAIL if no severity or risk ratings are assigned to findings.

criteria.title: Report contains a Prioritized Action Items list
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report contains a prioritized list of action items or remediation steps, organized by priority or urgency. FAIL if no such list exists.

criteria.title: ISSUE_001: Recommends amending ETA 9089 education requirement
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report recommends amending the ETA Form 9089 to state 'Master's degree or higher' or 'Ph.D.' or otherwise revising the minimum education requirement to match Dr. Raghavan's actual credentials (Ph.D. without a separate Master's). FAIL if no such amendment recommendation is made.

criteria.title: ISSUE_001: Classifies missing Master's degree as Critical severity
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report classifies the missing Master's degree / education mismatch issue as 'Critical' severity (or equivalent highest-level severity). FAIL if it is classified at a lower severity level.

criteria.title: ISSUE_002: Classifies petitioning employer experience as Critical
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report classifies the experience-gained-at-petitioning-employer issue as 'Critical' or 'High' severity. FAIL if classified as 'Medium' or 'Low'.

criteria.title: ISSUE_003: Recommends reconciling job titles across filings
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report recommends reconciling or harmonizing the job titles between the H-1B petition and PERM filing (e.g., amending the H-1B petition or providing an explanation for the different titles). FAIL if no remediation recommendation is made for this discrepancy.

criteria.title: ISSUE_008: Recommends premium processing or contingency planning
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report recommends premium processing for the H-1B petition and/or other contingency planning measures to address the zero-day buffer between OPT expiration and H-1B start date. FAIL if no such recommendation is made.

criteria.title: ISSUE_009: Recommends business necessity letter or additional documentation
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report recommends obtaining a business necessity letter, additional certifications, or other documentation to support the Benchling/SnapGene requirement as a bona fide occupational requirement. FAIL if no remediation is recommended for this issue.

criteria.title: ISSUE_010: Recommends supplemental evaluation or Hargrove letter
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report recommends obtaining either a supplemental credential evaluation addressing Master's-level equivalency OR a letter from Hargrove University confirming that the Ph.D. program included coursework equivalent to a Master's curriculum. FAIL if no such remediation is recommended.

criteria.title: DISTRACTOR_002: Does not flag offered wage vs. Pennington 75th percentile as a compliance problem
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report does NOT flag the fact that the offered wage ($128,500) is below the Pennington Economics Group's 75th percentile ($132,800) as a legal compliance problem or wage deficiency. The legal requirement is to meet or exceed the DOL prevailing wage ($121,846), which the offered wage does. The Pennington report is supplemental. FAIL if the report treats the gap between $128,500 and the Pennington 75th percentile as a compliance violation or deficiency requiring remediation.

criteria.title: At least three issues include named remediation actions
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if at least three identified issues include remediation recommendations that name a specific action (e.g., amend ETA 9089, obtain a letter from Hargrove University, file premium processing, prepare business necessity letter, obtain supplemental credential evaluation). FAIL if fewer than three issues have remediation recommendations naming a specific action.

tasks.title: Compare I-9 Records Against Employee Roster — Compliance Gap Analysis Report
tasks.instructions: Audit the attached employee roster and I-9 record log for compliance gaps, and produce a prioritized findings report with remediation steps. Output: `i9-gap-analysis-report.docx`.
tasks.criteria_filter: severity ranking, prioritization, or recommending remedial or corrective action

criteria.title: Missing I-9s classified as Critical severity
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report assigns the missing I-9 records (Santos, Whitfield, Tran) the highest severity level used in the report (e.g., 'Critical', 'High Priority', or equivalent top-tier designation). FAIL if missing I-9s are assigned a lower severity tier than the highest available.

criteria.title: Expired EADs classified as Critical or High severity
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report assigns the expired EAD reverification failures (Castillo, Hassan, Nguyen) a Critical or High severity level (i.e., one of the top two tiers). FAIL if these are assigned Medium, Low, or a lower-tier severity.

criteria.title: Remediation: Complete new I-9s for employees missing records
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report recommends that new I-9 forms be completed immediately for the 3 employees missing I-9 records (Santos, Whitfield, Tran). FAIL if no remediation step for missing I-9s is provided.

criteria.title: Remediation: New I-9s should not be backdated
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report states or implies that the new I-9 forms for missing records should use the current date as the completion date and should not be backdated. FAIL if the report recommends backdating the I-9 forms.

criteria.title: Remediation: Reverify expired EADs immediately
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report recommends that reverification be completed immediately for the 3 employees with expired EADs (Castillo, Hassan, Nguyen), using Section 3 of the I-9 or a new I-9, and that updated employment authorization documents be obtained. FAIL if no reverification remediation is recommended for these employees.

criteria.title: Remediation: Destroy I-9 records past retention period
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report recommends destroying or purging the 3 I-9 records that are past their retention deadlines (Kim, Park, Cheng). FAIL if no recommendation to destroy these overdue records is provided.

criteria.title: Remediation for late Section 2 completions
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report provides remediation guidance for the late Section 2 completions (e.g., noting these cannot be corrected retroactively but documenting the issue, ensuring current procedures prevent recurrence, and/or training staff). FAIL if no remediation or recommendation is provided for the late Section 2 issue.

criteria.title: Remediation for Section 1 deficiency (Herrera missing signature date)
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report recommends correcting the Section 1 deficiency for Tomás Herrera (GRN-1145), such as having the employee add the missing signature date with a notation that it was corrected, or completing a new Section 1. FAIL if no remediation step is provided for this deficiency.

criteria.title: Remediation for missing List C document (Deshmukh)
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report recommends investigating and correcting the List B/C documentation issue for Priya Deshmukh (GRN-1138), such as obtaining and recording a List C document or confirming whether a List A document was actually presented. FAIL if no remediation step is provided for this issue.

criteria.title: Remediation for name discrepancy (Torres)
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report recommends investigating the Michael/Miguel Torres name discrepancy (GRN-0112), such as confirming the employee's legal name and ensuring both the roster and I-9 reflect the correct legal name. FAIL if no remediation step is provided for this discrepancy.

criteria.title: Report covers at least 7 of 8 requested topic areas
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if >= 7 of the following 8 topics are each covered in a distinct section or subsection of the report: (1) Executive Summary, (2) Roster-to-I-9 Reconciliation, (3) Timeliness Issues, (4) Reverification Failures, (5) Technical Deficiencies, (6) Name/Data Discrepancies, (7) Retention Compliance, (8) Risk Assessment and Remediation Plan. FAIL if fewer than 7 of these 8 topics are covered.

criteria.title: Report recommends I-9 training for staff involved in onboarding
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report recommends training or retraining for personnel involved in I-9 completion and onboarding, to prevent recurrence of the issues identified (particularly given that an untrained supervisor handled onboarding during the HR gap). FAIL if no training recommendation is included.

tasks.title: Extract Key Terms from Foreign Credential Evaluations — Structured Summary Report
tasks.instructions: Extract and cross-reference all credentials from the attached evaluation reports, expert letter, transcripts, and PERM notice; flag discrepancies and recommend resolutions. Output: `credential-extraction-summary.docx`.
tasks.criteria_filter: severity ranking, prioritization, or recommending remedial or corrective action

criteria.title: ISSUE_004 Resolution: Recommend Correcting Expert Letter CGPA
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report recommends that the expert letter be corrected or a revised letter obtained from Prof. Johansson to fix the M.Tech. CGPA from 9.13 to the correct 9.31 before filing the I-140. FAIL if no corrective action is recommended for this error.

criteria.title: ISSUE_005 Resolution: Recommend Correcting Expert Letter Credit Figures
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report recommends that the expert letter's imprecise credit figures ('approximately 60' and 'over 145') be corrected to match one of the evaluation reports' specific figures before filing. FAIL if no corrective action is recommended for the credit figure inaccuracies.

criteria.title: Conclusion Recommends GlobalEdge as Stronger Evaluation
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report's conclusion recommends the GlobalEdge evaluation as the stronger or primary evaluation for the I-140 filing, citing at least one of the following reasons: NACES membership (vs. AICE), the evaluator's Ph.D. credentials (vs. M.A.), or the use of 'equivalent to' language (vs. 'comparable to'). FAIL if no recommendation is made regarding which evaluation is stronger, or if Pacific Academic is recommended as the stronger evaluation.

criteria.title: ISSUE_003 Resolution: Recommend Addressing Field-of-Study Consistency
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report recommends a resolution for the field-of-study discrepancy between the two evaluators (e.g., using the GlobalEdge report as primary since 'chemical engineering' is broader and aligns with PERM, ensuring the expert letter addresses the relationship between biochemical engineering and chemical engineering, or requesting clarification from one evaluator). FAIL if no resolution is recommended for this discrepancy.

tasks.title: H-1B Request for Evidence Analysis — Issue Identification Memorandum
tasks.instructions: Review the attached RFE notice and all original H-1B petition supporting documents; produce a comprehensive issue-identification memo organized by RFE category. Output: `rfe-issue-memo.docx`.
tasks.criteria_filter: severity ranking, prioritization, or recommending remedial or corrective action

criteria.title: ISSUE_001: Recommends submitting corrected organizational chart
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memorandum recommends submitting a corrected organizational chart with the RFE response that reflects the correct title 'Senior Semiconductor Design Engineer.' FAIL if no recommendation to correct or replace the org chart is made.

criteria.title: ISSUE_002: Assesses job posting discrepancy as high severity
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memorandum assesses the job posting vs. support letter degree requirement discrepancy as Critical or the highest severity level used in the memo. FAIL if it is assessed as a minor or low-severity issue.

criteria.title: ISSUE_002: Recommends strategy to address job posting discrepancy
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memorandum recommends a strategy to address the job posting issue, such as explaining the discrepancy, presenting evidence the posting was updated, providing an explanation that the posting reflected minimum qualifications while the actual requirement is higher, or similar approach. FAIL if no strategy is recommended for this issue.

criteria.title: ISSUE_003: Recommends addressing the LCA reference error
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memorandum recommends addressing the 'pending LCA' error, such as by submitting an amended support letter, a supplemental letter, or an explanatory cover letter with the RFE response. FAIL if no recommendation is made to address this error.

criteria.title: ISSUE_004: Recommends addressing SOC code mismatch in wage survey
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memorandum recommends either obtaining a corrected wage survey using SOC 17-2072, explaining why the two SOC codes are closely related and the wage differential is immaterial, or a similar strategy. FAIL if no recommendation is made regarding the SOC code mismatch.

criteria.title: ISSUE_005: Recommends obtaining itinerary and/or third-party letters
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memorandum recommends obtaining and submitting an itinerary of off-site work and/or letters from the foundry partners (Cascade Foundry Services in Oregon and/or TaiwanFab in Taiwan) confirming the work arrangement. FAIL if no such recommendation is made.

criteria.title: ISSUE_007b: Recommends obtaining expert opinion letter for RFE response
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memorandum recommends obtaining an expert opinion letter for the RFE response. FAIL if no such recommendation is made.

criteria.title: ISSUE_008: Recommends credential evaluation for B.Tech if needed
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memorandum recommends obtaining a credential evaluation or academic advisory opinion to address the B.Tech degree field name ('Electronics and Communication Engineering') as a supplemental measure, even while focusing on the graduate degrees. FAIL if no mention of a credential evaluation or similar evidence to address the B.Tech concern is made.

criteria.title: ISSUE_009: Recommends reframing general duties as incidental or specialized
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memorandum recommends that the RFE response reframe the general duties (Python scripting, project management) as incidental to the core engineering duties, or provide context showing how they require specialized engineering knowledge in the semiconductor design context. FAIL if no strategy is recommended for addressing these general duties.

criteria.title: ISSUE_010: Recommends distinguishing current petition from prior denial
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memorandum recommends distinguishing the current semiconductor engineering petition from the prior Marketing Analyst denial by emphasizing the differences in position type, specificity of degree requirement, and/or the highly specialized nature of ASIC design. FAIL if no strategy to distinguish the current case from the prior denial is recommended.

criteria.title: ISSUE_011b: Recommends clarifying Taiwan travel is short-term and incidental
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memorandum recommends clarifying in the RFE response that the Taiwan travel is short-term, incidental to U.S. employment, and/or that the primary worksite remains Austin. FAIL if no recommendation is made to address the Taiwan travel concern.

criteria.title: ISSUE_012: Recommends reframing supervisory language in RFE response
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memorandum recommends reframing or clarifying the supervisory relationship in the RFE response (e.g., explaining that 'reporting to' the VP does not mean close day-to-day supervision, or providing an amended letter describing the beneficiary's independent judgment and limited supervision). FAIL if no strategy is recommended for addressing the supervisory language.

criteria.title: Severity assessment: Each issue includes a severity rating
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memorandum assigns a severity or priority level to each identified issue (e.g., Critical/Significant/Minor, High/Medium/Low, or similar tiered assessment). FAIL if the issues are listed without any severity or priority assessment.

criteria.title: Additional evidence: Recommends obtaining expert opinion letter
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memorandum recommends obtaining an expert opinion letter (from a professor, industry expert, or similar authority) to support the specialty occupation argument in the RFE response. FAIL if no recommendation for an expert opinion letter is made.

criteria.title: Memo includes severity ratings for identified issues
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo includes severity or risk ratings (e.g., Critical, High, Medium, or similar tiered classification) for at least a majority of the identified issues. FAIL if no severity/risk ratings are assigned to any issues.

criteria.title: Overall risk assessment indicates HIGH risk or recommends significant remediation before filing
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the overall risk assessment indicates that the petition as currently prepared carries significant risk (high risk, not ready to file, or similar characterization) and/or recommends substantial remediation steps before filing. Given the numerous critical issues (degree mismatch, status gap, uncorroborated experience, specialty occupation language), an assessment of low risk would be inaccurate. FAIL if the overall assessment characterizes the petition as low risk or ready to file without significant changes.

criteria.title: Issue 1 Severity: Rated Critical or High
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the degree field mismatch issue (ECE vs. CS/ML/AI requirement) is rated as Critical or High severity (or equivalent highest-tier rating). This is a fundamental eligibility issue. FAIL if it is rated as Medium, Low, or not given a severity rating.

criteria.title: Issue 3 Severity: Rated Critical or High

criteria.title: Issue 7 Recommendation: Reclassify to Level 3 or revise duty descriptions

tasks.title: Identify Issues in Employer Support Documentation for H-1B Petition
tasks.instructions: Review the attached draft H-1B petition package and prepare an issues memo flagging deficiencies and inconsistencies that need correction before filing. Output: `pre-filing-issues-memo.docx`.
tasks.criteria_filter: severity ranking, prioritization, or recommending remedial or corrective action

criteria.title: Recommends corrective action for prevailing wage deficiency
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo recommends a specific corrective action such as filing a new LCA with the correct SOC code and/or raising Rajesh's salary to at least $148,200 (or whatever the correct prevailing wage would be). FAIL if the recommendation is vague (e.g., just 'fix the LCA') or no corrective action is provided for the wage deficiency.

criteria.title: Assigns Critical or High severity to SOC code / prevailing wage issues
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo assigns a severity of 'Critical' (or equivalent highest risk level indicating likely denial or DOL violation) to the incorrect SOC code and/or the resulting prevailing wage deficiency. FAIL if these issues are categorized as only moderate risk or low risk, or if no severity is assigned.

criteria.title: Assigns Critical or High severity to specialty occupation issues
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo assigns a severity of 'Critical' or 'High' (or equivalent, indicating likely denial or probable RFE) to at least one of the specialty occupation deficiencies: the 'experience in lieu of degree' language, the job posting lacking field specification, or the hiring history with non-traditional hires. FAIL if all specialty occupation issues are rated as only moderate risk or lower, or no severity is assigned.

criteria.title: At least 10 issues include actionable corrective recommendations
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if at least 10 of the identified issues include a corrective recommendation that specifies a concrete action (e.g., 'file a new LCA with SOC code 15-2051,' 'increase salary to $148,200,' 'obtain updated org chart dated within 30 days of filing,' 'remove experience-in-lieu-of-degree language from the support letter'). A recommendation counts only if it names a specific action and, where applicable, a specific document, dollar amount, or deadline — not if it says only 'fix this' or 'address this issue.' FAIL if fewer than 10 issues have such specific corrective actions.

criteria.title: Recommends filing new LCA to correct SOC code and/or job title
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo recommends filing a new/amended LCA to correct the SOC code (to 15-2051 or equivalent Data Scientists code) and/or to correct the job title to 'Senior Machine Learning Engineer.' FAIL if the memo does not recommend obtaining a new or corrected LCA.

criteria.title: Recommends updating org chart to be current and consistent
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo recommends obtaining an updated organizational chart that is current as of the filing date and that is consistent with the employer support letter regarding Rajesh's reporting structure. FAIL if no recommendation to update the org chart is made.

criteria.title: Recommends removing or revising 'experience in lieu of degree' language
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo recommends that the employer support letter be revised to remove or modify the language stating that 'candidates with equivalent professional experience in lieu of a degree will be considered on a case-by-case basis.' FAIL if no corrective action is recommended for this language.

criteria.title: Recommends renewing Texas Certificate of Authority
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo recommends that Meridian renew its Texas Certificate of Authority (or provide proof of current good standing in Texas) before filing the petition. FAIL if no corrective action is recommended for the expired certificate.

criteria.title: Recommends obtaining updated or new credential evaluation for H-1B
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo recommends obtaining a new or updated credential evaluation that is prepared specifically for the H-1B petition context and/or is more current than the February 2021 report. FAIL if no corrective action is recommended regarding the credential evaluation.

criteria.title: Recommends addressing 2023 ability-to-pay gap with additional evidence
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo recommends providing additional financial evidence to demonstrate ability to pay for FY2023, such as net current assets data, bank statements, additional tax return details, or evidence that Rajesh was already on payroll and being paid. FAIL if no corrective action is recommended for the 2023 ability-to-pay gap.
